scope: Six second-wave fact-checked catalog buyer introductions; no lid performance or certificates claimed

sports.2310: Sports model 2310 is listed at 1,000 ml with an approximate 7.7 by 29 cm format and a PC, PP, ABS plus overmolded-component material entry. That last item distinguishes the material inquiry from nearby model 2309, whose catalog entry does not list an overmolded part. It does not establish where the extra material sits or how the bottle feels in use. Ask the factory to identify the component on an assembled sample and confirm its grade and drinking-contact role. For buyers comparing a taller promotional bottle against an 800 ml choice, verify the actual total height, closure clearance and finished packing. Black-gray, pink-blue, army-green and blue-orange gradients are listed color references; approve actual color and artwork samples instead of assuming screen previews match production.
sports.2511: Sports bottle 2511 is a 550 ml catalog model measuring 7.6 by 19 cm, with gradient blue, purple, black and pink color references. It offers a distinct artwork discussion from model 2501, which shares the same listed nominal size but has a different catalog color range. For event merchandise, confirm whether the chosen gradient and the requested logo stay visually legible together on a real sample. The component listing includes PC, PP and ABS, not an identified food-contact grade for each part. Ask for a photograph of the assembled closure, the position of any seal, and a component-by-component material breakdown. The catalog mentions individual OPP bags; confirm what the final wholesale packing includes before estimating carton volume or approving a color-matched production run.

kids.2319: Kids bottle model 2319 has a 600 ml catalog capacity and an 8.8 by 19.5 cm reference size. Unlike many adjacent catalog entries, its listed component materials include silicone alongside PC, PP and ABS. That distinction makes a parts-level inquiry essential: the source does not say whether the silicone is a seal, grip or another part, so the buyer should ask for an exploded view or a physical sample. Mint green, pomegranate red and purple are the catalog color options, not evidence of a verified age rating. A school-supply importer should inspect detachable pieces, cleaning access and the complete closure before describing suitability for a target age group. Confirm printed artwork boundaries, bag packing and destination-market documentation for this exact assembly.
kids.2410: Model 2410 is a 750 ml children's bottle reference with a 9.8 by 16 cm catalog dimension, substantially different in proportion from taller 750 ml models. The listed component materials are PC and PP, not the PC, PP and ABS grouping found in many other kids entries. For a retailer considering shorter display shelves or school bags, request a measured production sample; the dimensional listing does not confirm the handle, lid or total packed height. The source records purple, red and grass-green variations, subject to an actual color sample. Ask the factory to show each drinking-contact component and demonstrate how the assembled closure is opened and washed. Avoid inferring child-safe certification, spill resistance or suitability for a specific school age from a category label alone.

jugs.2280: Large-capacity model 2280 is listed at 1,600 ml and roughly 11.8 by 23.5 cm, paired in the source with pink-green, black-gray, blue-orange and purple-blue gradient colors. The capacity may resemble model 2290, but the color references and listed dimensions should be checked separately rather than treating the two as interchangeable stock. For importers planning a coordinated gym assortment, ask whether each gradient can be supplied consistently across the selected order and verify the physical logo-printing zone. PC, PP and ABS appear as component families without a verified lid or handle construction. The source lists mixed frosted drawstring-bag packing and 40 units per master carton; confirm dimensions, internal protection and the actual variant before using the carton figures for freight estimates.
jugs.2302: Model 2302 occupies a smaller 1,100 ml position within the large-jug collection, with a listed 12.3 by 20 cm format and 48 pieces per master carton. These figures help a wholesaler compare it with the taller 1,600 ml model 2303, which shares a color family but differs in listed dimensions and carton size. Black-white, pink-purple, blue-orange and green-pink gradients are reference options, not guaranteed availability for every purchase order. Before preparing an online listing or retailer presentation, request the full assembled bottle and verify the drinking opening, closure parts and carrying arrangement. PC, PP and ABS are listed, while detailed resin grades and compliance depend on the approved variant. Confirm print area, packing and carton measurements on the actual production sample.
